{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Degrowth is necessary to realize global justice for all human beings and communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group stands firmly against imperialism and racial capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The group supports decolonizing the global economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Full decolonization requires a thorough application of equity and an end to unequal ecological, material, and financial exchange.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Contraction and convergence—where the Global North’s energy and material use contracts so that societies in the Global South can increase their resource use to meet their needs—is necessary to achieve a globally fair material foundation for human flourishing within biophysical boundaries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The group acknowledges the ways colonial history has shaped capitalism and the international political economic order.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"To be effective, degrowth must be an internationalist ecosocialist project.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Degrowth must address colonial history in its proposals and political strategies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The group supports transforming the international economic and financial architecture that maintains Northern power through coercion and oppression of Southern nations, peoples, and popular movements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The group supports ending debt strangulation, sanctions, corporate domination, and political disenfranchisement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A degrowth transition in the Global North must be democratic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The group is committed to creating a post-growth, ecosocialist world democratically.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
